//: Solution file for the desktop app. The three Electron layers are separate TS projects on purpose: it is the type system, not convention, that stops the renderer from reaching into main-process code.
//paths: The `@/*` alias is declared here as well as in ./renderer/tsconfig.json. This copy is not used for compilation (this project has no inputs) — it exists so tooling that resolves aliases from the nearest tsconfig at the app root, notably the shadcn CLI reading ./components.json, lands on renderer/src. Keep the two in sync; they must point at the same directory.
